notes.title: Beta Version 1
notes.content:
Now that I have everything working correctly, I plan on starting to add more to the game. Stuff like guns, and potentially even a new map, and/or overhaul of Oregano is in the works. There's still lots of work to be done, but I expect I will need to upload a hotfix, as it's more than likely that things just break. 

Below is the changelog for Beta v1:
- added "new" lobby map, you can no longer walk of the edge of the map
- fixed guns not reloading for clients
- fixed not changing levels on game start
- fixed only the host being able to choose weapons
- removed guns while in the lobby (might bring back a shooting range at some point but we'll see)
- fixed pregame timer for clients
- fixed clients not being able to communicate with key actors in the scene
- fixed teams not being assigned properly
- fixed the number of people alive not displaying properly (I think)
- fixed an issue with drones
- fixed an issue where the operator select screen wouldn't show up
- fixed a crash when readying up
- fixed the pause menu softlocking you while in the lobby
- fixed an issue where the player wouldn't leave a server after leaving via the pause menu
- added a settings menu (just a back button for the time being, but hey, it doesn't softlock you anymore)
- fixed an issue where the game wouldn't automatically focus

These are issues that I am aware of, and plan on fixing:
- issues with the left arm on the character model
- an issue with collision that allows players to shoot through walls
- shotgun pump animation not playing when fired
- you currently cannot access already placed drones, only create new ones
- issue with the camera after the player dies
- cannot sprint or crouch at the moment

I have intentionally removed both sprinting and crouching for the time being, as they will require a rewrite of the charactermovement component. I do plan on adding vaulting, laying down, and rappelling alongside crouching and sprinting, but it could take a bit of time.


And finally, this is a list of every feature that I plan on adding/am currently working on to implement:
- advanced movement (as mentioned above)
- animations
- audio, using steam audio 
- cameras
- grenades
- highlighted teammates
- more gamemodes
- more maps
- more weapons
- proper recoil patterns
- proper spawn locations for attack and defense
- secondary weapons
- the ability to go prone
- tools
- UI

And of course, I'm currently learning the UE5 chaos system, in the hopes of implementing the destruction system before May of 2025. Whatever state the game is in, once I release the (hotfix patch of the) destruction system, the game will become open for early access to all. If this seems like a lot of stuff that I am going to be working on, that's because it is, I honestly don't expect more than half of these things to make it into the game before early access (mainly grenades, tools, and especially new maps).

I would also like to note that while it is not listed here, I do want to add actual operators to the game. The problem is that I don't just want them to use the same model as the recruit, as well as some other worries about implementation, but suffice to say, they are going to take a while.
